title: DE · TKG compensation
subtitle: Prepare a transparent prospective claim for a complete outage in Germany.
de_scope: Germany-specific · TKG §58 · no legal advice or promise of success
candidate_title: Start with a proposal or a manual window
candidate_help: Monitoring and incidents are proposals, not legal evidence. A manual window always works.
appointment_only_help: For a missed-appointment-only claim, leave the window blank and continue to the facts step.
candidate_empty: No supporting proposal is available. Enter the window manually.
candidate_ongoing: Ongoing proposal through the latest available evidence; no restoration is inferred.
complete_outage: I confirm a complete outage, not merely slow or unstable service.
independent_claims_help: Complete-outage compensation and missed-appointment compensation are independent. Outage details are required only when complete outage is selected.
performance_path: For slow, unstable, or reduced service, use the official Bundesnetzagentur measurement procedure instead.
monthly_fee_help: Enter the contractually agreed monthly fee. Bundle allocation is not inferred.
zero_fee_help: At €0.00, the statutory flat amounts still apply.
day_help: A proposed day remains unconfirmed until you select complete outage. Include the restoration day only if it was a complete-outage day.
day_replacement: Provider replacement solution actually made available
replacement_help: A confirmed replacement solution excludes only that day conservatively. Acceptance or suitability is not inferred.
user_responsibility: I confirm own responsibility or contributory responsibility.
lawful_interruption: I confirm a legally permitted interruption.
calculation_empty: Confirm and calculate the facts first.
credit_separate: A prior credit is shown separately and is never deducted automatically.
rounding_note: Fractional-cent percentage results use Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to the nearest cent. This is a disclosed product rule, not quoted law.
letter_language: The provider-facing letter is intentionally German regardless of the interface language.
letter_placeholder: Generate the letter after reviewing the calculation.
report_chunk_note: The 90-day split is a technical PDF limit, not a limit on the claim period.
no_reports: The Reports module is unavailable. Copy and .txt export remain available.
send_yourself: DOCSight does not send anything. Review the text, then use the provider portal, email, or post yourself.
escalation: Further guidance: Bundesnetzagentur consumer portal and Verbraucherzentrale.
status_letter: German letter generated. Review and edit it.
status_copy_failed: The letter could not be copied. Select the text and copy it manually.
status_stale: Facts changed. Recalculate and regenerate the letter.
status_letter_stale: Letter details changed. Generate the letter again.
status_error: The request could not be completed.
validation_window: Enter both window bounds or leave both blank for an appointment-only claim.
validation_facts: Enter the fee and either confirm the outage facts or at least one missed appointment.
waiting_period: The report-receipt date is day 0; no TKG §58(3) entitlement is calculated before the third calendar day after receipt.
disclaimer: Not legal advice and no promise of success. Providers or courts may assess the facts differently.
